summary: Apps have configure, suspend and resume callbacks, state restoration, launch URLs and documents, and a size-derived layout model with a top safe inset. There is no scene concept (several UI instances per app), no trait collection, no device idiom query, no orientation API and no status bar control for apps.
rea_evidence: not captured: tools/parity/rea-page.sh reported 'no CDP browser on 127.0.0.1:9333 (run: tools/parity/rea-page.sh --start)'; facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: the App trait has configure, event, draw, suspend, resume, menus and commands; background task time and remote notification callbacks are only partly covered by the notification services

features.apple: Responding to the launch of your app, launch options, URL schemes
features.note: Input::Open delivers URL and file launches; URL types are registered through bundle resources
ToApp::Suspend and Resume exist, with cgroup control for background apps; no background modes or execution time requests beyond begin_activity (springboard/sdk/src/process_info.rs)

features.apple: UIScene, UIWindowScene, UISceneSession, UISceneDelegate, multiple instances
features.note: one app owns one surface in the shell protocol; there is no scene session, no request for a second window and no per-scene restoration. Needed for multi-window apps on the tablet

features.apple: Preserving your app's UI across launches, NSUserActivity
features.note: save and restore of window state across relaunch, logout, update and crash; no user activity handoff
battery and sensors are reachable; apps have no form-factor query (desktop or tablet idiom), which B3 defines

features.apple: UITraitCollection (size classes, display scale, userInterfaceStyle, preferred content size)
features.note: Layout derives margins and size classes from the window size and Ctx::appearance is queryable; no trait collection object with change callbacks, no horizontal and vertical size class pair as a type
top_inset exposes the top safe inset; apps cannot hide the status bar or the home indicator
the shell rotates on accelerometer data and apps see only a new Configure size; apps cannot declare supported orientations and the turn plays as a shell animation (area B7)
observable values; views are not invalidated automatically from reads

features.apple: tab bar and sidebar, document launch, multitasking
features.note: sidebar and documents exist; no tab bar (see uikit-views-controls)
extension points declared by hosts and a file provider; no keyboard or share extension runtime
bundle resources and asset lookup; no storyboards or nibs, by design (views are built in code)
porting path for the vendor's own apps
no way for an app to publish quick actions that the shell shows on long press of its icon; the shell has icon edit mode only (springboard/src/shell/jiggle.rs)

gaps: Scene sessions: a way for an app to open and close several windows, with per-scene restoration
Trait collection object with size class pair and change callback
Form-factor idiom query for apps (B3 owns the definition)
Status bar and home indicator hiding
